rows.title: Source authority and compiler-authored claims are explicit
rows.packBoundary: Every source-backed value is sourced, derived, supplemental, or explicitly unresolved.
rows.regressionForm: Source/license and composed-label predicates reject unsupported or falsely quoted output.

rows.title: Source segmentation, ownership, continuations, and locators are complete
rows.packBoundary: Record and field boundaries retain complete source ownership and locators.
rows.regressionForm: Boundary, continuation, and provenance predicates cover every affected record family.

rows.title: Taxonomy, identifiers, tables, and structured field shapes are stable
rows.packBoundary: Structured values preserve source qualifiers, empty cells, grouping, and typed identifiers.
rows.regressionForm: Corpus-wide field-shape and taxonomy predicates reject drift.

rows.title: Canonical relationships and non-exact discovery are durable
rows.packBoundary: Canonical owners, aliases, topics, and qualified duplicate names are discoverable.
rows.regressionForm: Lookup predicates resolve canonical records without exact kind/title knowledge.

rows.title: Atom presence cannot stand in for clause-complete procedures
rows.packBoundary: Captured, projected, supported, and discoverable are separate clause dimensions.
rows.regressionForm: A clause-level completeness predicate fails partial and atom-only representations.

rows.title: Choices, alternatives, variants, and option-local behavior remain distinct
rows.packBoundary: Mutually exclusive choices and variants retain stable identity, prerequisites, and local behavior.
rows.regressionForm: Option-selection tests prove sibling alternatives are not cumulative.

rows.title: Class features, feats, resources, resets, and scaling are executable
rows.packBoundary: Deterministic feature procedures preserve use counts, resets, scaling, and lifecycle.
rows.regressionForm: Feature procedure and progression tests exercise each governing clause.

rows.title: Rule, action, and condition procedures are explicit without regressing typed effects
rows.statusReasoning: CAP-002 overstates the condition deficit: existing typed condition effects are exact against source. Repair only proven structural gaps and preserve those effects.
rows.packBoundary: Rule and condition clauses expose readiness and lifecycle while preserving correct typed effects.
rows.regressionForm: Condition exactness and no-regression tests run beside structural readiness predicates.

rows.title: Ancestry, background, equipment, and grants retain deterministic semantics
rows.packBoundary: Grants, choices, constraints, uses, and embedded choices/currency are typed.
rows.regressionForm: Grant and equipment procedures assert source-supported values and choices.

rows.title: Spell procedures include complete geometry, pools, branches, and lifecycle
rows.packBoundary: Every deterministic spell clause has complete representation or explicit non-engine disposition.
rows.regressionForm: Spell corpus predicates cover geometry, targeting, saves, pools, and termination.

rows.title: Creature attacks, saves, outcomes, variants, and legendary economy are complete
rows.packBoundary: Creature clauses preserve alternate modes, riders, saves, timing, lifecycle, and budgets.
rows.regressionForm: Exhaustive creature clause predicates cover alternate attacks, saves, damage, and lifecycle.

rows.title: Hazards, pits, poisons, diseases, and traps are stateful procedures
rows.packBoundary: Hazard detection, triggers, branches, geometry, recurrence, cure, and termination are represented.
rows.regressionForm: Hazard-family predicates exercise success branches and variant procedures.

rows.title: Magic-item clauses are decomposed and their execution boundary is honest
rows.statusReasoning: Pack projection can enumerate item clauses, but complete execution remains dependent on the engine capability families and their owning beads.
rows.packBoundary: All magic-item source clauses are represented, with green clauses proven complete and pending clauses disclosed.
rows.regressionForm: Every item clause is enumerated and readiness/engine dependencies are generated.

rows.title: Readiness metadata reflects semantic completeness
rows.packBoundary: Partial, pending, unimplemented, and design-blocked clauses cannot be reported as green.
rows.regressionForm: Generated readiness predicates fail hidden pending clauses and stale zero-finding metadata.

rows.title: Every required engine capability has qualified ownership
rows.statusReasoning: Capability membership is generated from the pack and completion is owned by the engine:F1 through engine:F10 family beads; the registry records the dependency until those families certify.
rows.packBoundary: Each deterministic clause exposes required engine capabilities and fail-closed ownership.
rows.regressionForm: Generated hook queries and bead-reference checks reject unowned capability gaps.
